name: Deep Energy Clearing Fundamentals & Advanced: Purchased Together (Live via Zoom)
description:
Overview

As we explore our existence as physical and energetic beings, we recognize the importance of both our physical systems and our energy channels. While scientific evidence supports the existence of our energy fields, we often neglect them. This program is designed for those who wish to deepen their understanding and ability to clear energy, not just for themselves but for others.

In our daily lives, we are surrounded by a multitude of energies that can influence our emotions and actions. This can lead to feelings of overwhelm or negativity, creating a cycle that feels difficult to escape.

Our Advanced Level 2 course equips you with refined techniques to connect deeply with your energy self while learning to clear energies affecting others—be it individuals, animals, families, or environments. You will gain confidence in navigating energetic clearings without becoming attached to the energies you oversee.

As we stand at a pivotal moment in our world's evolution, your role as a catalyst for transformation becomes crucial. This course prepares you to make profound changes, whether you intend to offer these services professionally or simply as a personal practice.

Buckminster Fuller said, “You will never build a better world by fighting the things you don't like. If you want a better world, find a new model that makes the old model obsolete, and people will follow the new model and the old will fall away”.

Become a Certified Practitioner

Upon completing both the Basic and Advanced programs, you will need to fulfill the following requirements to become a certified practitioner:

  • Complete at least 20 energy clearings.
  • Conduct an observed clearing with a qualified observer from the Ravenall Institute ($150 fee).
  • Receive your certification and logo.
  • Pay your annual membership fee (choose from various membership options) and maintain your membership to keep your certification active. This ensures you continually update your skills, explore new clearing categories, and benefit from ongoing knowledge and workshops.

Embark on this rewarding journey and enhance your practice!

description:
How our unconscious beliefs & how we think trips us up

We think 60-70,000 thoughts in one day and 90 percent, based on underlying memorized beliefs and programmes. And these are the same thoughts as the day before, these very same thoughts lead to the very same choices, these very same choices lead to the same behaviours and the very same experiences, and all of these choices, behaviours and experience invoke emotions, and hence your experiencing the same emotions and the same feelings as the day before. These very same feelings and emotions drive the exact same thoughts, behaviours and actions. And so the cycle begins again.

If these choices, experiences and thoughts are helpful as opposed to harmful you can create and manifest what you want in your life = great – however if these are harmful then its like ground hog day feeling a little like you have your finger on the rewind and playback button and ultimately this leads to failure, unhappiness, exhaustion and in many cases disease.

These subconscious patterns interfere trip us up and prevent our ability to have the happiness, abundance, performance and fulfillment in work, relationships, and health that we desire. Many of these patterns are not yet in the conscious awareness, yet they have a major impact on our overall life.

Our unconscious patterns cause our reality

Your biology, neurocircuitry, neurobiology, hormones and genetic expression will always be equal to what you believe, how you think, behave, act and feel, your personality creates the reality that you experience in your life.  Your personality is made up of what you believe, how you think,  feel, behave and act . This personality becomes the day to day personal reality and this personal reality is what we call our day to day life.

How to Change

To change it you have to face the underlying unconscious beliefs and think and challenge what you have been thinking about, delving into and noticing the unconscious habits and behaviours that are making up the life experience that you are currently having and then make a decision, to stay in the parking lot of the experience that you are currently having or change it and create a new reality and new life experience and ultimately new.

What’s the challenge you have to change? trying to and create a new reality by keeping the same personality is impossible! If you keep thinking the same way, the thinking leads to the same behaviours, the same actions and the same feelings and emotions there is no change.

Neuroscience tells us, nerve cells that fire together wire together. As you keep choosing the same ways – your brain fires in the same combinations, in the same way, every day. So we reproduce the same every day and this gets our brain into a fixed way of being, and this becomes the box of our brain. So thinking outside the box is getting your brain to fire and work differently.
